The '''Republic Defense Procurement Office''' was the branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was charged with procurement and resource requisition for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Located at the [[Logistics center]] at [[Coruscant Command HQ]], it was in permanent contact with the military's [[Logistics battalion]]s and [[Fleet Ops]], as well as the civilian contractors responsible for producing and transporting weapons and equipment.

One branch, [[Procurement Development]], was responsible for developing, testing and acquiring new technology and equipment.

Another division of the office was the [[Transport Maintenance]].
